summary: The @gyomu/schema package provides a comprehensive, domain-driven schema and validation framework built on top of Effect and Standard Schema. It defines foundational error handling structures, entity definitions, CRUD schema generators, and utilities for source code and metadata analysis.
responsibilities: Define domain-specific entity schemas, field definitions, and UI annotations that automatically generate complete CRUD schema suites.
Establish a centralized, type-safe error handling strategy with consistent diagnostic context, operational policies, and recovery traits.
Provide advanced structural schema representations for TypeScript code analysis, symbol management, and dependency tracking.
Offer low-level infrastructure utilities including result wrappers, JSON schema representations, and robust date/time manipulation routines.

capabilities.name: Entity Schema Generation
capabilities.description: Defines business entity structures and automatically generates corresponding insert, update, and select CRUD schemas.

capabilities.name: Domain Error Handling
capabilities.description: Provides classified application errors equipped with operational logging policies, context metadata, and retryability traits.

capabilities.name: TypeScript Code Analysis Schemas
capabilities.description: Supplies rich structural models for analyzing symbols, type properties, imports, exports, and JSDoc annotations.

capabilities.name: Result and Validation Flow
capabilities.description: Encapsulates operation outcomes using standardized success and failure result schemas with integrated field-level error mapping.

capabilities.name: Date and Time Utilities
capabilities.description: Handles local dates, year-month periods, and business calendar transformations required by domain entities.

designDecisions: Leverages the Effect ecosystem and Standard Schema specifications for robust, type-safe runtime validation and error tracking.
Uses schema-driven code generation to keep database access models, entity definitions, and UI annotations tightly synchronized.
Employs branded types and strict nominal identifiers for keys, paths, and user identifiers to prevent accidental primitive confusion.
usageGuidance: Use the provided entity definition builders to declare domain models and automatically derive their corresponding CRUD schemas.
Wrap fallible operations using the package's standardized result schemas and domain error structures to ensure consistent error reporting.
Leverage Effect-based schema conversion utilities for safe data decoding and encoding across application boundaries.
